parts.question_text:
A conducting wire has length 5.8 m and cross‑sectional area 3.4 × 10^{-8} m^{2}. The resistivity of
the metal of the wire is 5.6 × 10^{-8} Ω m.
Calculate the resistance of the wire.
resistance = Ω

the metal of the wire is $5.6 \times 10^{-8}\,\mathrm{\Omega}\,\mathrm{m}$.
